requirements.description: Add search filters allowing users to narrow results by category and city
requirements.label: needs_clarification

tasks.task: Confirm platform capabilities and design filter UI/UX
tasks.assumption: Platform has a basic search page and can be extended with UI components

tasks.task: Implement front‑end filter controls (category and city dropdowns) and integrate them with the existing search form
tasks.assumption: Front‑end framework allows adding new form fields without major refactor

tasks.task: Extend back‑end search API to accept category and city parameters and modify the query accordingly
tasks.assumption: Search logic is encapsulated in a service that can be updated

tasks.task: Add or adjust database indexes for category and city fields to maintain query performance
tasks.assumption: Database schema includes searchable fields for category and city

tasks.task: Testing: unit tests for API changes, UI tests for filter behavior, and regression testing of overall search
tasks.assumption: Automated test suite is in place and can be extended

requirements.description: Streamline the member addition process to reduce manual admin effort
requirements.label: needs_clarification

tasks.task: Gather detailed requirements and design the streamlined member addition workflow (e.g., bulk CSV import, email invitation, self‑service signup)
tasks.assumption: Stakeholders can provide a clear definition of the desired automation (bulk upload format, invitation triggers, etc.) within the planning session

tasks.task: Develop backend service to process member CSV uploads: parsing, validation, duplicate handling, and database insertion
tasks.assumption: The platform already has a Member entity and DB schema; only import logic needs to be added

tasks.task: Create admin UI for CSV upload with progress indicator, error reporting, and preview of parsed records
tasks.assumption: Existing admin panel framework can be extended without major redesign

tasks.task: Implement email invitation workflow for newly added members (template creation, queuing, handling bounces)
tasks.assumption: The platform has a working email service integration that can be reused

tasks.task: Testing, QA, and documentation: unit tests, integration tests, user acceptance testing, and updating admin guides
tasks.assumption: Test environment mirrors production and documentation standards are already defined

requirements.description: Implement a monthly newsletter that is sent only to members who have opted in
requirements.label: needs_clarification

tasks.task: Add opt‑in flag to member profiles and expose it in the user settings UI
tasks.assumption: Platform allows extending the user schema and customizing the settings page without core code changes.

tasks.task: Create an admin interface for drafting and scheduling the monthly newsletter content
tasks.assumption: An existing CMS/admin panel can host custom forms/pages for newsletter authoring.

tasks.task: Implement a scheduled job that queries opted‑in members and sends the newsletter via the existing email service API
tasks.assumption: The platform provides a cron‑like scheduler or background worker framework and has an integrated email service SDK.

tasks.task: Add unsubscribe handling (link in email updates opt‑in flag) and ensure GDPR/ CAN‑SPAM compliance
tasks.assumption: Incoming link clicks can be routed to a lightweight endpoint that updates the user's opt‑in status.

tasks.task: Write unit/integration tests and perform manual QA of the end‑to‑end newsletter flow
tasks.assumption: A test environment with representative member data is available for automated and manual testing.

requirements.description: Fix the mobile homepage layout so the menu does not overlap the logo and looks good on phones
requirements.label: needs_clarification

tasks.task: Investigate current mobile homepage markup and CSS to identify why the menu overlaps the logo
tasks.assumption: The site uses standard HTML/CSS with a responsive framework (e.g., Bootstrap) and source files are accessible.

tasks.task: Implement CSS changes (media queries, z-index, padding/margin adjustments) to separate the menu from the logo on typical phone widths
tasks.assumption: No custom JavaScript is required for the menu positioning; pure CSS fixes are sufficient.

tasks.task: Test the updated layout across a range of common device widths and browsers using emulators and real devices
tasks.assumption: Testing can be performed with available emulator tools and a handful of physical devices.

tasks.task: Update any related documentation, commit changes, and perform a quick regression test of the homepage
tasks.assumption: The deployment process is straightforward and does not require additional approvals.
